_note: One entry per plugin page. Hotspots are [x %, y %, name, what it lets you do] on the view's image. Every fact comes from docs/<plugin>-manual.md; check there before changing one. Lead crop boxes are [left, top, right, bottom] in % of the image.

groups.name: Dynamics
which: Even out a vocal, bass or drum bus
comp
One compressor over the whole signal, with every control on one page.
Control only the lows or highs of a bus
multicomp
Each band has its own compressor, and untouched bands pass through flat.
Silence a drum mic between hits
gate
It opens on the hit and closes after it, with a filter on what it listens to.
Stop peaks at the end of a master
limit
A brickwall ceiling measured in true peak, with a loudness meter beside it.
Soften “s” sounds, with full control
ds
Threshold, frequency, range and two ways of cutting.
Soften “s” sounds, quickly
ds-mini
One Amount knob on the same engine.
Shape the attack and ring of drums
ts
It turns each hit’s start and tail up or down, the same on quiet hits as on loud ones.

groups.name: Tone
which: Shape the frequencies of a track
eq
Up to 24 bands on a live analyzer or in one list, any of which can act only when needed.
Remove steady noise or ringing
fir
It works on the spectrum itself, so it can take out what an EQ can’t.
Add brightness and presence
exciter
It makes new harmonics above a frequency you choose, instead of boosting what’s there.
Add warmth or grit
sature
Six kinds of saturation, at a steady level.
Add low end to a kick
kicker
It swells the kick’s own note, or adds a sub an octave or two below it.

groups.name: Space and time
which: Add echoes in time with the song
delay
Up to 16 taps, each with its own time, feedback and colour.
Put a sound in a real space
verb
It plays the sound through a recording of a room, a hall or a plate.
Add a room or hall you can shape
room
Size, decay and damping move freely, and the tail can freeze.
Add width and shimmer
chorus
Copies of the sound, gently moving in pitch and spread across the stereo field.

comp.name: Comp
comp.line: The threshold sits on the input meter, with a filtered detector and a sidechain.
comp.lede: A compressor with its threshold on the input meter, a sidechain, a filtered detector and an output limiter.
hub: For evening out a vocal, a bass or a drum bus, and for anything that needs a sidechain.
Set the threshold right on the input meter
Compress from a sidechain or a filtered detector
Lift quiet passages with upward compression

multicomp.name: MultiComp
multicomp.line: Up to 8 bands of compression that sum back flat.
multicomp.lede: A multiband compressor with up to 8 bands. Each band has its own compressor, and the bands sum back flat when they aren’t compressing.
hub: For a bus or a full mix where only part of the spectrum needs control.
Split the signal into up to 8 bands that sum back flat
Drag crossovers and thresholds on the graph
Put a band on Mid or Side only

Mute the band, put it on Stereo, Left, Right, Mid or Side, hear it alone, or switch it off.

Ratio, knee, attack, release, RMS size and gain for the selected band.

After the bands, at the end of the master.

gate.name: Gate
gate.line: Closes between hits, ducks from a sidechain, lifts loud parts and sends MIDI.
gate.lede: A noise gate, ducker and upward expander with hysteresis, hold, a transient detector, optional 50 ms lookahead, a sidechain input and MIDI triggering.
hub: For drum mics and noisy tracks, and for ducking one track under another.
Close a mic between hits
Look ahead 50 ms so no attack is cut
Send a MIDI note every time it opens

views.label: Main view
views.alt: Fancy Gate’s main view
points: Set where the gate opens, on top of the input meter, with the closing level shown below it.
Open from the track itself or from a sidechain.
Open 50 ms early, so not even the first transient is cut.
Close on silence, turn the track down while the sidechain plays, or lift what’s above the threshold.
Watch the level and the gate opening and closing over the last few seconds.
How fast it opens, how long it stays open, and how slowly it closes.
Close only part of the way, so the gate never sounds abrupt.
Filter what it listens to, so only the snare opens a snare mic.
Send a MIDI note on every opening, to trigger a sample.
Blend the gated and ungated sound, and add white noise only while it’s open.
Open on the level, or on a sudden rise in level, whatever the level is.

limit.name: Limit
limit.line: Holds a master under a ceiling, with a loudness meter beside it.
limit.lede: A true-peak brickwall limiter with lookahead, three styles, Auto release, a loudness meter and dither, for the end of a mix or a master.
hub: For the end of a mix or a master.
Hold peaks under a true-peak ceiling
Work to a loudness target with the built-in meter
Hear only what the limiter removes

ds.name: DS
ds.line: Turns down “s” sounds only while they’re too loud.

ts.name: TS
ts.line: More or less snap and ring on every hit.
ts.lede: A transient shaper: it turns the start of each hit up or down (Attack) and the ring after it (Sustain), the same on quiet hits as on loud ones. Use it to make drums snap or sit back, tighten a loop, tame a room or bring out a pluck.
hub: For drums, loops and plucked instruments.

Shorten a boomy room
Shape from a sidechain
